entries.content: Health-check design rule: a monitoring check must distinguish 'I could not measure this' from 'this is broken'. model-manager.mjs now has an 'unmonitored' status for providers with no HEALTH_ENDPOINTS entry — it is logged loudly (console + provider-unmonitored ledger event) but never latches down, never swaps an agent's model, and never fires highSeverityFailure. Same failure class as egress-preflight REQ-006. Any new provider added to budget.json must ship with a probe; tests/adapter-and-model-manager.test.mjs enforces this.
